utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many more helpers do you still need, and what jobs should I pass along?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I could still use a few more hands, especially someone good with tools, someone to sort supplies, and a couple folks to greet people on the porch. If you know anyone handy, send them my way for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive is this Saturday on the front porch. I could still use a few helpers if anyone’s free.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, we moved it to Sunday at the community center, so I’m lining up helpers there instead. Can you still help us out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help this Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll ask around for a couple more hands too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That helps a lot, and I’d appreciate you asking around.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help a bit, but I need the timing and what tools to bring. Just let me know who’s coming so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Pia. It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I’m still lining up the helper list, so I’ll send you the timing and tools once I’ve got everyone set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch. Can you help there instead?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’ll help there instead. I’ll let the others know the plan changed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help if the timing and materials are clear. Just send me the details so I know what’s needed at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a huge help, Pia. It’s this Saturday around 10 on the front porch, and I’ll send the details on what we need.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
